hero.description: Explore a second voice for your recording. Create a piano part
hero.descriptionEnd: or try experimental vocal harmony from your own performance.

upload.title: Your recording
upload.hint: A clear lead vocal gives the best results. Start with a verse or chorus you love.

modes.title: Processing modes
modes.bypass: Separation bypassed. Your recording becomes the lead vocal; the instrumental stem is silent.
modes.separate: Separate the lead vocal and instruments with Demucs.
modes.vocalHint: Pitch-shift your existing vocal performance. No MIDI is generated.
modes.pianoHint: Render harmony notes with a sampled piano and export MIDI.
modes.reset: Changing output restores its mixer defaults.
modes.warning: Above and Below have sounded robotic in listening tests. Early pitch changes, missing consonants and formant artifacts may occur. This is not production quality.

harmony.title: Shape your harmony
harmony.diatonicHint: Diatonic harmonies use scale-aware quantization in the same key. Choose the key of your song.
harmony.fixedHint: Fixed intervals transpose by an exact number of semitones. Chromatic quantization works in any key.
harmony.keyRequired: Choose the recording's musical key and scale before generating scale-based harmony. No key is detected automatically.

mixer.title: Find your balance
mixer.hint: Applied to the next generated preview. Reduce the lead without turning down the instruments.
mixer.vocalHint: Vocal presets use lower gains. High gains can overwhelm the lead; peak protection lowers the whole mix.
mixer.pianoHint: Piano gain can exceed 1× to bring up quiet samples.

generate.title: A new perspective on your melody
generate.ready: Your recording is ready. Let’s find its second voice.
generate.empty: Add a recording to begin your session.
generate.retry: After fixing the issue, Generate harmony starts a fresh upload. Earlier server jobs may still finish.

progress.label: Generation progress
progress.cpu: CPU separation can take several minutes.
progress.keepOpen: Keep this tab open while your audio is processed.
progress.failed: Processing stopped. See the message below.
progress.complete: All six stages complete. Your harmony is ready to hear.
progress.idle: Six steps from your recording to a second voice.

results.title: Listen to the possibilities
results.emptyHint: Upload a recording, find your interval, and let the harmony unfold.
results.noNotes: No voiced notes were detected. The harmony track is silent; try a recording with a clearer lead vocal.
results.protection: Peak protection reduced the whole mix by {{db}} dB. Your relative track balance is preserved.
results.take: Take it to your next session

footer.note: Made for exploration. Harmony follows your detected melody; a clean vocal and the right key make all the difference.
footer.tagline: A second voice for your ideas.

errors.pitch: Pitch analysis failed. Try a clearer vocal recording and check the server logs.
errors.export: Could not save the melody. Check available disk space, file permissions and server logs.
errors.unknown: Processing failed. Review the technical details and server logs.
errors.format: Choose a WAV or MP3 file.
errors.empty: This file is empty. Choose another recording.
errors.size: This file exceeds 20 MiB. Choose a smaller recording.
errors.invalidAudio: Cannot read this audio. Choose a valid WAV or MP3 recording.
errors.long: This recording is longer than 30 seconds. Trim it before uploading.
errors.metadata: Audio metadata could not be read. Try another WAV or MP3 file.
errors.browser: Your browser cannot read this file. Choose a valid WAV or MP3.
errors.playback: Playback failed. Check your connection or download the file.
errors.unavailable: Audio unavailable. If the API restarted, generate the harmony again.
errors.session: This audio session is no longer available. Upload again; restarting the API clears local sessions.
errors.network: Cannot reach the API. Start FastAPI on port 8000 and check the proxy configuration.
errors.requestTimeout: The request timed out after 20 minutes. The server may still be working. Check its logs before trying again.
errors.separation: Vocal separation failed. Check the backend logs and Demucs installation.
errors.pollTimeout: Separation is taking too long. Stopped polling; the server may still be processing. Check its logs before starting again.
errors.separationTimeout: Separation exceeded 15 minutes. Check the server logs before retrying.
errors.harmonyResponse: The API returned an invalid harmony response.
errors.renderResponse: The API did not return all rendered files. Check the backend logs.
errors.json: The API returned an unreadable response. Check the API URL.
errors.job: The API returned an invalid job response.
errors.rubberband: Install Rubber Band 3+ and configure HARMONYFINDER_RUBBERBAND. Check the executable and DLLs.
errors.fluidsynth: Configure FluidSynth and a SoundFont. The MIDI file may still be available.
errors.ffmpeg: Install FFmpeg and ffprobe and add them to PATH.
errors.prerequisite: Complete the previous processing stage before continuing.
errors.busy: This task is already running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.scale: Check the selected key and scale. Diatonic harmony needs compatible scale-aware quantization.
errors.render: Rendering failed. Check the server logs; completed files may remain downloadable.
errors.preparation: Vocal preparation failed. Use mono/stereo audio at 8–192 kHz and check the decoder installation.

warnings.vocal: Experimental vocal harmony: robotic artifacts, early pitch transitions and missing consonants may occur. Not production quality.
warnings.fallback: Separated stems are unavailable; original-plus-piano fallback cannot independently control the lead vocal
